decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core cheese range, so keeping it costs little, though its absence from the website in 2020-2021 weakens the evidence of its value.
As a multi-variant line, weak variants can be pruned while the line stays open, so dropping it outright despite thin recent evidence is not yet justified.
The mild soft cheese rounds out the soft-cheese offer at low carrying cost, but its lack of visibility since 2019 raises the chance it is quietly phased out.
The niche washed-rind soft cheese has shown no sign of traction for three years, so its uncertainty has largely resolved against it and its resources are better redeployed.
